title: Executive Decree No. 25-302 of 25 Djoumada El Oula 1447 corresponding to November 16, 2025
summary: Regarding the approval of the licence for the establishment and operation of the fifth-generation (5G) mobile electronic communications network open to the public and the provision of related services, granted to the company “Wataniya Télécom Algérie S.P.A.”
